eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 11:54 PM on AUG 20, 2021 Effective until 9:54 AM AUG 21, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Phoenix Police Department is looking for Bonnie Molina, a white female, 76 years of age. Bonnie is 5 feet, 5 inches tall, and 120lbs with blue eyes and gray hair. She was last seen on-foot in the area of 12th Street and E.Thomas Road, in Phoenix, on August 20th.  Bonnie was seen wearing a tan colored shirt, blue jeans, black shoes, and a tan & purple baseball hat. Bonnie suffers from dementia and gets disoriented easily. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
